title.provenance: The general assembly has found and declares that: [...] It is desirable as a first step in reducing the toxicity of packaging waste to eliminate the addition of these heavy metals and PFAS to packaging; and [...] The intent of this chapter is to achieve this reduction in toxicity without impeding or discouraging the expanded use of post-consumer materials in the production of packaging and its components.

location.provenance: STATE OF RHODE ISLAND IN GENERAL ASSEMBLY JANUARY SESSION, A.D. 2022

status.provenance: AN ACT RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

date.provenance: Introduced By: Representatives Cortvriend, Speakman, Carson, Morales, Marszalkowski, McGaw, Ruggiero, Fogarty, Donovan, and Kislak Date Introduced: February 11, 2022

pfas_definition.provenance: (l) 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: No food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.
